I have identified the two protocols serving MemoService. I am now locating the exact file paths and registration details for each.

Connect RPC is registered in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` via `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`. It mounts at `/memos.api.v1.*` in `v1.go`. Wrapper methods live in `connect_services.go`.

The gRPC-Gateway JSON-over-HTTP endpoint is registered in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`. It mounts at `/api/v1/*`. Generated registration code sits in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`.

No native gRPC server exists. The service implements gRPC interfaces but serves them through the in-process gateway and Connect. I am now extracting the exact registration snippets from the generated gateway file and the Connect handler.

I have gathered sufficient evidence to identify both protocols and their exact file paths.

Connect RPC serves browser clients. Registration occurs in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`, `connect_services.go`, and `v1.go`. Generated handler code lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`.

The second protocol is gRPC-Gateway, a RESTful JSON API. Its registration path is still being identified.

gRPC-Gateway is registered in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)`, mounted at `/api/v1/*`. Generated gateway code lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/mem...`. No standalone native gRPC server exists; the service interfaces are exposed through these two HTTP-based protocols.

Generated Connect code supports Connect, gRPC, and gRPC-Web. The wrapper type in `connect_handler.go` is named `ConnectServiceHandler`.
